Marketplace product query

API for querying marketplace products.

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Product/mall_product_list.php?iteminfo_url=XML_URL[URL-encoded]

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. Required st_date string Start date
3. Required ed_date string End date
4. partner_product_id string Your own product code (product management code) Product code managed in your own system
5. partner_product_yn_view string Whether to show the customer product code Allowed values
  • -Y : Show all products, whether or not a customer product code is set
  • -N : Show only products with a customer product code
 Default : N
6. page string Page number Specify the page number when there are more than 1000 products
7. total_standard_count string Total items displayed per page The default is 1000 records
8. mall_id string Marketplace code Allowed values
  1. - Collect all : no code
  2. - Collect by marketplace :
* Enter this code accurately. If the marketplace is not listed, add it in the marketplace setup.
ex )APISHOP_0001
9. detail_desc_yn string Show detailed description Allowed values
  • -Y : Show product details
  • -N : Hide product details
 Default : N

XML sample

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr"?>
<Shoplinker>
	<productInfo>
		<Product>
			<customer_id>a1234567</customer_id>
			<st_date>20110709</st_date>
			<ed_date>20110711</ed_date>
			<partner_product_id>a123</partner_product_id>
			<partner_product_yn_view>N</partner_product_yn_view>
			<page>1</page>
			<total_standard_count>500</total_standard_count>
			<mall_id>APISHOP_0000</mall_id>
		</Product>
	</productInfo>
</Shoplinker>

Response

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. count_all string Total product count Located in MessageHeader
2. total_page string Total pages Located in MessageHeader
3. currently_page string Current page Located in MessageHeader
4. currently_count string Number of products displayed on the current page Located in MessageHeader
5. total_standard_count string Total items displayed per page Located in MessageHeader
6. partner_product_id string Customer product code
7. shoplinker_id string Shoplinker account
8. product_id string Shoplinker product code
9. mall_name string Marketplace name
10. mall_id string Marketplace code
11. mall_user_id string Marketplace account
12. mall_product_id string Marketplace product code
13. mall_product_name string Marketplace product name
14. sale_price integer Sale price
15. supply_price integer Supply price
16. sale_status string Sale status Allowed values
  1. - On sale : 001
  2. - Sales suspended : 003
  3. - Sold out : 004
  4. - Sales ended : 006
17. update_status string Whether the product update succeeded Allowed values
  1. - Y : Success
  2. - N : Failure
18. err_msg string Error message
19. end_date string Product end date
20. register_date string Registration date
21. master_id string Auction/Gmarket only
22. mall_group_name string Marketplace product group name
23. mall_product_url string Product URL
24. maker string Manufacturer
25. origin string Country of origin
26. barcode string Barcode
27. market_price_p integer Supplier market price
28. sale_price_p integer Supplier selling price
29. supply_price_p integer Supplier supply price
30. detail_desc string Detailed description
31. new_desc_top string New detailed description
38. new_desc_center string Additional component detailed description
33. new_desc_bottom string Advertising/promotional details
34. desc_type_tag string Quality labeling TAG and detailed description
35. quantity string Available supply quantity
36. keyword string Product keywords (short product name)
37. model integer Model name
38. model_no string Model NO When using isbn (book code), the value must start with "isbn-".
39. brand string Brand name
40. auth_no string auth_no
41. option_info string Option information
42. item_group_no string Product disclosure group seq
43. item_group_title string Product disclosure group title
44. gosi_name string Individual product disclosure title
45. gosi_seq string Individual product disclosure seq
46. gosi_value string Individual product disclosure content
47. market_price integer List price
48. update_date string Update date
48. mall_category string Category information
50. send_date string Last transmission date
51. esm_ver string Whether this is an ESM 2.0 product Allowed values
  1. - Y : Enabled
  2. - N : Disabled
